resources.string: WebShare is off. Connect the PC to the same Wi-Fi, or start a hotspot on this phone and join it from the PC.
WebShare is running. Open the address below in the PC browser.

Wi-Fi and hotspot share one radio on most phones, so turning the hotspot on will drop your current Wi-Fi connection — that is expected. Multicast (mDNS) is often blocked on phone-hosted hotspots, which is why the plain address is always shown. Files are served straight from this device; nothing touches the internet.
Open Wi-Fi settings and turn on the hotspot, then connect the PC to it. Morselink will pick the address up automatically.
